resources.string: How much has been downloaded and uploaded
Since the router was turned on
The router counts from when it was turned on: it starts again from zero when it restarts.
The router has no internet connection right now, or it doesn\'t let the app see how much goes through it.
Tap a bar to see that hour.
Tap a bar to see that day.
Usage chart for %1$s: %2$s downloaded and %3$s uploaded
The router is now keeping track of usage. The chart will fill up as time goes by: it\'s updated every hour.
See the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days
For that, the router has to keep track of what\'s used. This installs vnStat, which takes about 3 MB and saves once an hour so it doesn\'t wear out the router\'s memory.
It needs about 4 MB free and the router has %1$s left.
vnStat is installed, but it isn\'t counting the internet connection or it keeps the data in memory that\'s wiped when the router restarts.
Setting up vnStat (takes up to a minute)…
The router doesn\'t let the app install packages.
The router doesn\'t let the app write its scheduled tasks, so it can\'t be made to keep track of usage.
The router has no internet connection right now: there\'s nothing to keep track of.
vnStat didn\'t start counting the internet connection, so everything was left as it was.
vnStat couldn\'t be made to save to the router\'s storage: what it counts would be lost when it restarts. Try again.
Nothing counted yet. Each device shows up once it uses something (it takes half a minute).
For that, the router has to count each device\'s connections. This installs nlbwmon, which takes less than 1 MB and saves once an hour.
It needs 1 MB free and the router has %1$s left.
nlbwmon is installed, but it keeps its data in memory that\'s wiped when the router restarts. Setting it up starts counting from zero.
nlbwmon is installed but its settings are missing. Reinstall it from LuCI.
nlbwmon didn\'t start again with the change, so everything was left as it was.
In nlbwmon\'s current period (set in LuCI).
